comment: Only two registers open at 5pm, waited 20 minutes in line with a basket of six things.
Self-checkout kept freezing and there was a long line for the one staffed lane.
Love the bakery but the checkout queue on Saturdays is out the door.
Waited forever to pay. Please open more lanes after work hours.
The line at the register was so long I left my cart and went home.
Prices on cereal went up again, two dollars more than last month.
Floor near the dairy cooler was sticky and nobody cleaned it.
Cashier was friendly but the wait to check out was still 15 minutes.
Shelf for oat milk was empty again, third week in a row.
Couldn't find any eggs at all, the whole section was out of stock.
The weekly flyer advertised chicken thighs but they were sold out by 10am.
Half the canned soup shelf was bare.
Rotisserie chicken was gone by noon, no restock until evening.
Checkout was quick and the staff were helpful.
Bananas were bruised and the avocados were already brown.
Out of my usual coffee again, had to buy a different brand.
Strawberries were moldy the day after I bought them.
Lettuce was wilted and slimy in the bag.
The tomatoes were mushy and the peppers soft, produce looks old.
Bought peaches that were rotten inside.
Produce section looks tired, bruised apples everywhere.
Prices are a bit high compared to the store across town.
Parking lot was full of carts and trash.
Long line at the deli counter, only one person working it.
